name_en: Senzanki — bone-in chicken deep-fried whole, Imabari's version of karaage
summary_ja: 若鶏を骨付きのまま一口大に切り、下味を漬けてから片栗粉をまぶして揚げる今治の唐揚げ。骨から出る旨味が味を深めるとされ、祝い事から弁当まであらゆる場面で食べられているという。
summary_en: Bone-in young chicken, cut into bite-sized pieces, marinated, and dusted in potato starch before frying — Imabari's take on fried chicken. The bone is said to deepen the flavor, and it turns up everywhere from celebrations to packed lunches.
source_title: せんざんき 愛媛県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Ebiten — a fried cake of ground shrimp, shell and all, worked into tofu
summary_ja: 殻ごとすりつぶしたジャコエビを白身魚や豆腐と練り合わせ、油で揚げる東予の練り物。塩分を抑えて豆腐の甘みとエビの香りを立たせ、殻のジャリっとした歯ざわりが持ち味とされる。
summary_en: Small shrimp are ground shell and all, worked with white fish and tofu, and fried into a cake — a fish-paste product from eastern Ehime. The salt is kept light to let the tofu's sweetness and the shrimp's aroma come through, with the ground shell left in for a gritty bite.
source_title: えび天 愛媛県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
